notes.title: big update
notes.notes:
@@main
@ Add English version
-Translate texts necessary for game progress, such as interfaces and missions

@ Added inventory that acts as reinforcement, weapon engineering, genetic combination, skillset, guide, etc.

@ 6 kinds of sub contents added
-TOP5: Ranged Combat Content
-Hundred Per One: Fight multiple enemies
-Duel of Honor: close combat content, Blade Storm appeared
-Activator Battle: Survival by canceling the activator
-Boss Rush: Named or higher type, battle with high-level units
-Aria for Vicente: Become tactical computer Vicente and support degenerated swordsman Aria

@ Engineering Enhancement is added to Weapon Engineering.
-AI units also receive engineering enhancements. (Number of Rounds x 4 x Level Coefficient)

@ Added auto-return function upon death in general field.
-Mineral drops upon death, cocoon created at the location of death, recovery of dropped minerals when acquiring minerals after destroying the cocoon
-If you die and return from an area that has been attacked during the Quintra subjugation, the area will collapse.

@ Add recognition timing to AI units from the second round
-The timing at which AI units can immediately react to surrounding dangers without first-delay.
-Instantaneous reaction is limited to 4 patterns: 'front interception', 'dash', 'bouncing', and 'moving'
- Decreased cognitive range when blinded
- Impossible to respond immediately when desensitized


@@ Build related changes
@ Default gene socket 8 -> 9

@ Gene socket increase per round 1 -> 2

@ 'Poison sac-Neuro paralysis' downgraded
-Muscle strength damage coefficient 5.4% -> 4.8%
-Moving speed damage coefficient 3.6% -> 2.4%

@ "Spinning organ-Improvement of Viscosity"'s moving speed damage reduced
-Chemical coefficient 6% -> 5%
-Other molecular coefficient 4% -> 2.5%

@ Added immunity penetration to "Pathogen sac-information blocking"

@ Add Bite skill to wolf gene
- Added HP absorption rate to the skill Bite

@ Adds +4 energy additional fixed recovery to "Laser Drone Gene"

@ Add +7% knockback force to crusher gene

@ Add dash shockwave function to TitanEX gene

@ Add Blade Storm gene

@ Add 10% knockback withstanding force to "Exoskeleton-Upper Body"

@ "Explosive Bullet Launcher-Detection Sensor" changed to interceptable
  10% increased resource consumption
  5% increase in delay

@ Reactor - endothermic reactor resource consumption -5% -> -10%

@ "Tactical circuit-Visualization the eyesight range" effect change
-In case of back attack, total damage is increased by 15% -> Increases Additional damage by back attacks by 30%

@ Reactor-Improvement conductivity resource consumption -25% -> -20%

@ Blade-Lunge change penetration rate +30% -> 20%

@Blade-Cone change penetration rate +50% -> 30%

@ Swing blunt defense, stun tolerance damage muscular strength coefficient lowered to 14%

@ Exoskeleton-compatible exoskeleton defense absorption +50% -> +40%

@ additional reduction rate of poisoning damage 15% -> 25%

@ "poison sac-Catalysis" changes
-Maximum effect 12% -> Reduced until the additional reduction rate reaches 7.5%
-Debuff increase 1% --> 0.5%

@ When applying "tactical circuit-Battle state analysis", it is possible to check the recognition timing after the 2nd round

@ The effect of "tactical circuit-Multiple identification" is extended to first-delay, after-delay, and recognition timing.

@ The secret of photosynthesis Gene's energy proportional recovery 2% -> 1%

@ Reducing stem cell consumption when returning stat reinforcement
-Consumes 1 stem cell when return at each step -> Consumes 1 stem cell when return at multiples of 5 steps.

@ "Pointed Bullet Launcher-Shotgun" delay +45% -> +60%


@@etc
@ Scenario text partially modified

@ Defense per level of Gene Controller 2 -> 3
Desensitization tolerance per level 4 -> 3
// It was determined that the number of instant deaths of the gene controller was high and the play experience was problematic.

@ Biotechnology Lab Arcsa kan appearance time 30 -> 25 seconds

@ Added a Focused interceptor construction block mission after the arrival of the second team during the confrontation with Regis Mind.

@ Change the type of enemy check units during subjugation battles
-Great White Shark -> Swift Hunter
- Jellyfish -> Wolf

@ Add direction lock function

@ Change the player's counter exposure time.
- Skill delay's 35% -> 50%

@ Invincible while jumping

@ In the battle of Quintra, you can interact with the whirlpool in the central barracks to check the effects of the mid-boss and allies camp again.

@ Added save space before playing Yuseah and Grave in Danes Henton's Legion host search battle.

@ Moving speed calculation formula changed
- The movement speed of units and skills is slower than before to increase the player's reaction rate to long-range attacks and tracking
-The moving speed is changed to increase up to 6.5 (22.6 spaces/sec) due to the effect of stat. (Existing 7.9 (60 steps/sec) )
-Skills with a basic moving speed of 6.5 (22.6 steps/sec) or higher are not affected by stats.


@@ bug fix
-Fixed an issue where the return function was turned off when selecting No after interacting with the entrance to the abandoned warehouse.
-Fixed an issue where the received delay was abnormally low due to the enemy's bouncing
-Fixed a problem where the flammable gas firing skill obtained with the red dragon gene was created 2 spaces in front
-Fixed the phenomenon that the defense damage factor increases when returning "Saw blade change"
-Fixed an issue where when a weapon with 0 durability was destroyed, the number displayed in red even after repair was completed
-Fixed a phenomenon where the penetration rate was applied abnormally
-Fixed the problem that the tactical circuit icon remained abnormally
-Fixed a problem where the object text label remained when "save -> destroy the object -> save again" in Chapter 5 Broken Port
-Fixed an issue where the projectile was not hit when it was reflected twice
-Fixed an issue where durability becomes an abnormal value when the poison sac is destroyed
-Fixed a problem where skills with high movement speed passed units without hitting them
-Fixed a problem where the return location was removed when changing the type

notes.title: Bug fixes and some upgrades
notes.notes:
- Bug fixes
-Fixed a bug where invincibility, passage, and stealth were maintained when the map was moved while using tunnel digging.

--Changes
-Unit basic movement speed changed: 3.5 -> 4 (approximately 41% increase)
//At the beginning of the game, we decided that too slow movement speed could be frustrating.

-Added a notification that he recovered when interacting with the blue flame.
//I added it because there was no mention of the recovery function.

-Menu name change: Battle Guide -> Guide
// Corrected because it includes content other than the battle.

-Toxic antibody change:
  Consumption: 12% of current chemistry -> 20% of maximum toxic molecule
  Infection time reduction: 0.5 x (chemistry) / (500 + chemistry) -> 1.5 x (chemistry) / (500 + chemistry)
//We increased the consumption by 2 times to reduce the number of inputs, and we judged that the practicality was insufficient, so we increased the effect by 3 times and as a result raised 50%. (Additional time penalty also decreased)

-Changed the resource consumption increase of the engineering [Large-diameter bullet] of the thorn launcher:
  20% -> 15%
//We judged that resource consumption is high compared to performance.

-Improved the description of some build options and improved readability with a black background.

-Tactical circuit resource name change: Resource -> Brain Volume
//Return the name changed in the development phase.

-Change amount of movement speed R change while using laser:
  -1.5(-65%) -> -1.3(-60%)


--Other
-The trial version has been extended up to Chapter 2.

-Fixed a bug where the movement speed was abnormally fast when the interaction and the dash key were pressed simultaneously on the map movement scaffold.

List: Tactical Computer, aura Of Kan, tunnel Spider

notes.title: Balancing and bug fixes
notes.notes:
--reinforce
-Changed the amount of increase in the basic enhancement of stats.
[strike]20 and 1% increase[/strike]
25 increase.
//Constant increase and rate increase synergy, it was judged that it was forced to go all-in to one stat, and it was judged that the rate increase part broke the balance in the high-level section of the high reps, so adjustment was necessary. Due to the increase in the constant value, the difficulty of the early game was lowered and the difficulty of the latter was increased. Likewise, the number of enemies and allies gained through basic enhancements has been changed to the same.

--gene
-Electrical engineering
Plasma storm duration: 5 seconds -> 3 seconds
blindness tolerance change: -5% -> -3%
"Increases all skill resource consumption by 10% of the bomb launcher (0)" added.
//The balance test of the plasma storm, which was not yet confirmed, showed too high performance, so we drastically lowered it.

-Judge EX
Movement speed S change -6% -> -4%
Detoxification change -6% -> -4%
"Increases all skill delays of the bomb launcher (0) by 5%" added.
//Changed the penalty to be meaningful depending on the performance.

-Legion host
Added maximum flying distance. (3, 3)
Added "10% increase in delay of spider production skills".
//Because we checked the overwhelming performance of causing unilateral damage outside the enemy's view, we set the maximum value of the flying distance and added a delay penalty.

-Queen Spider EX
Resource consumption change 8% -> 12%
//We determined that the combat power of the warrior spider is superior, so we adjusted the penalty value accordingly.

-The Spore King
Spore monster production resource consumption increased by 20%.
//Fixed the phenomenon that the resource consumption is significantly lower than the original plan of the spore monster production skill.

- -Bug fixes
-Fixed the phenomenon that the next map could not be moved to the next map when acquiring minerals after saving in the broken port after killing the red dragon.

notes.title: Build and Bug Fix
notes.notes:
-Build modification-

Genetic modification: hemophilia
[strike]Whenever infected with a hospital application, the bleeding time is increased by 0.2 seconds.[/strike]
Whenever infected with a hospital application, the bleeding time is increased by up to 0.2 seconds.
  (The amount of increase in bleeding time is proportional to the rate of pathogen use, and is the maximum at 100%.)

Inhibition of clotting
[strike]Whenever poisoning is applied to poison, the bleeding time is increased by 0.2 seconds.[/strike]
Each poisoning by applying poison increases bleeding time by up to 0.2 seconds.
  (The amount of increase in bleeding time is proportional to the ratio of toxic molecules used, and is the maximum at 100%.)

//In the case of the bleeding meta gene controller, it was determined that the bleeding maintenance ability of the gas diffusion skill was abnormal and corrected.

-Bug fix-

Fixed a problem where the challenge "Red Dragon" was achieved when killed during battle with a red dragon.
